Name: Lucky Start
Author: Xvordan
Description:
By default, only the first day of a new game (Spring 1, year 1) has its daily luck set to max. You can configure the mod to  do this on the first day of each week, season, or year. You can also write day, and make every day have max daily luck.
  "LuckyStart": "day|week|season|year|game"

Manifest.Name: Lucky Start
Manifest.Description: Sets daily luck to maximum every day, or on the first day of a week, season, year, or game.
Manifest.Author: Xvordan
